facts.fact: Le Sahel reports a panellist at the April 2026 Niger IGF saying Niger 's'est doté' of a National Cybersecurity Strategy for 2023-2027, with four axes, to be implemented by the CNAC.
Le Sahel reports a panellist citing Niger's cybercrime law among the national legal texts in force that regulate cybersecurity.
Le Sahel reports a panellist citing Niger's law on protection of personal data among the national legal texts in force.

NER.note: Malabo is named only as a reference framework, no ratification stated; no authority named.
Sovereignty is named only in general terms; nothing on state data control.
Only the cybersecurity strategy is described, a thematic strategy.
Nothing on who runs government systems.
The IGF panel is an internet governance forum with no named law put to it.
Budapest ratification is a Council of Europe convention (other); Malabo and the AES roadmap are named with no signature, ratification or national effect stated.
